characters.description: A Bronze-rank adventurer who awakens in a new body on Earth after dying in another world. Unsure how long he has been gone or whether his former companions survived, he seeks help before approaching his immediate family.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: Jason's estranged uncle in Sydney, with connections to organized crime. Jason plans to approach him for information, cash, and help before contacting his immediate family.
characters.name: Hiro Asano

characters.description: Jason's intelligent shadow familiar. Shade withheld advance knowledge of Jason's possible revival because he feared Jason would take greater risks, but returns to serve as scout, adviser, concealment, and transport.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: One of Jason's combat familiars, resummoned inside Jason's newly expanded personal space. Gordon's return requires stored magical resources because Earth's scarce ambient magic cannot support the usual ritual without assistance.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Jason's healing familiar, restored alongside Shade and Gordon after Earth's scarce ambient magic complicates their return. Colin's spirit remained within Jason, but recreating a working vessel requires ritual materials and stored magical power.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: Jason's sister and a central connection to the family life he left behind. He first confirms from hiding that she and her household are safe, uncertain how to re-enter their lives after his long absence and presumed death.
characters.name: Erika Asano

characters.description: Erika's husband and Emi's father. Jason sees him with the family while covertly checking his childhood home, confirming that the household endured his disappearance before Jason decides whether it is safe to reveal himself.
characters.name: Ian Evans

characters.description: Jason's niece and the daughter of Erika and Ian. Jason secretly checks that she is safe at his childhood home before deciding when to disclose his return, knowing that his new magical circumstances could place the whole family at risk.
characters.name: Emi Evans-Asano

characters.description: Hiro's security and site manager.
characters.name: Taika

characters.description: A senior figure in Sydney's concealed magical organization. She directs investigations into exceptional magical arrivals in Australia and France, including the person-shaped anomaly at Jason's rebirth site.
characters.name: Annabeth Tilden

characters.description: An analytical investigator working under Annabeth Tilden. She examines the abandoned hospital and identifies the residual trace of a brief, person-sized magical event.
characters.name: Ketevan Arziani

characters.description: A greater vampire and member of the Cabal who meets Jason to exchange information about Earth's concealed magical world. He explains the Cabal's place among its major factions while Jason remains cautious about revealing his origins.
characters.name: Craig Vermillion

characters.description: The public identity given to the cloaked magical rider seen during the toll-road battle. Distorted news footage connects the figure with an earlier hospital miracle while leaving the person beneath the cloak uncertain to the public.
characters.name: Starlight Rider

characters.description: A mysterious artist whose painting of four pillars is recognized by Jason as representing himself and his familiars Colin, Gordon, and Shade.
characters.name: Dawn

characters.description: The Sydney organization's combat instructor. He studies recordings of Jason's unconventional fighting and recognizes techniques designed for capabilities beyond ordinary human limits. His assessment helps establish that Jason's outworlder account is credible.
characters.name: Nigel

characters.description: A high-ranked magical healer in Sydney. She exhausts herself keeping Jason's badly afflicted French attacker alive and finds his unusual conditions exceptionally resistant to removal. Her expertise gives the branch direct evidence of Jason's dangerous magic.
characters.name: Gladys

characters.description: A junior member of Sydney's magical steering committee. He offers Annabeth resources to contain the fallout from Jason's public battle and favors negotiation over coercion, regarding Jason's unusual knowledge and resources as strategically valuable.
characters.name: Keith Culpepper

characters.description: A hard-line member of Sydney's magical steering committee. She argues that Jason should be compelled to cooperate and that pressure on his relatives is an available tool. Her position conflicts with colleagues who believe betrayal would create a dangerous enemy.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: Jason's brother and Amy's husband. His guilt over the old relationship rupture resurfaces when he repeatedly thinks he has glimpsed the brother the family believes dead. Jason's possible return forces him to acknowledge the unresolved harm between them.
characters.name: Kaito

characters.description: Kaito's wife, Jason's former partner, and a childhood friend of the Asano family. Jason's return forces the family to confront the lasting damage surrounding her relationship with Kaito and the painful way her earlier relationship with Jason ended.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: A skilled prisoner held under a suppression collar. She studies the prison's magical array in secret and uses staged escape attempts to learn its design while her captors methodically try to break her resistance.
characters.name: The captive

characters.description: Jason's father. He welcomes Jason home without demanding immediate answers and regrets failing to protect him during the family conflict that preceded his disappearance. He hopes Jason can remain in Castleton Beach and recover among his relatives.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: Jason's mother, who learns at the hospital that her son is alive. His abrupt return places her among the relatives awaiting a full explanation of his disappearance and their family's connection to a remarkable recovery.
characters.name: Jason's mother

characters.description: An International Committee representative and magical research administrator who knew Jason at school. She joins the delegation to his houseboat and warns her colleagues that his experiences have profoundly changed him.
characters.name: Asya Karadeniz

characters.description: The tactical operations director overseeing a major incursion response. He is the strongest Category 3 operative present and commands the organized force Jason accompanies as an observer, placing him at the center of the Network's field response.
characters.name: Koen Waters

characters.description: A Sydney operative whose sensory recording captures Jason defeating a powerful monster alone. The experience leaves her deeply unsettled by the strength and character of his aura, which feels far more formidable than its apparent category suggests.
characters.name: Kylie Chen

characters.description: The operations director of the Leon branch. He is secretly holding and torturing an outworlder for knowledge while a deadline approaches for surrendering the prisoner to the International Committee. He seeks an outside arrangement to retain control.
characters.name: Adrien Barbou

characters.description: Jason's former teacher and friend, recognized from a photograph as the outworlder being held at Leon's concealed facility.
characters.name: Farrah

characters.description: The same Farrah Jason knew in the other world, now reborn on Earth as an outworlder. After Jason reaches her, a new trust-based ability confirms their bond and helps her accept his changed appearance and aura.
characters.name: Farrah Hurin
